notes: D-1 is Owner A1 in AUTHORIZATION.md and plan.md. D-2 is the effective Architect close judgment after three active CTGs, exact PR CI, independent reviews and DEVAI proofs, bound to Owner A2 in AUTHORIZATION.md. The historical migration criteria remain fail; Owner A1 authorized close without seal for the transferred historical migration criteria; the additional window-1 budget failure is covered only by the subsequent narrow Owner A2 authorization to emit this close with the FAIL preserved. The runtime task queue was never materialized because TASK_ROUND_INACTIVE held before AUTHORIZATION markers were added; prepared work/rounds task JSONs are historical checkpoints, not retroactive DEVAI execution transitions.
